criteria.criterion: GIS screen can be opened from launcher
steps_taken: Read the current canonical QA testing brief from docs/briefs/qa-testing.md.
Read only the assigned TEST2-4 criteria.md, ticket.json, and status.json before testing.
Used the existing authenticated V4 browser session at https://smartnetworkv4-o2-uk-dev.metricell.com/launcher; no sign-in prompt appeared and no credentials were entered.
Captured the initial launcher state locally.
Selected the GIS module Open module control from the launcher.
Observed navigation to https://smartnetworkv4-o2-uk-dev.metricell.com/gis and captured the GIS loading state locally.
Waited for the GIS workspace to load.

Verified the loaded GIS workspace displayed the GIS heading, layer group controls, Mapbox map area and attribution, map location search field, map style control, zoom controls, and user profile control.
Captured the loaded GIS workspace state locally.
